g.text: Compared with Sep 1 – Sep 12 (matching elapsed time): Cost: +12.4% · Tokens: +8.1% · Sessions: -3.0%
Most expensive sessions in this selection
Top 10 by known cost. Deleted sessions retain their usage but cannot be reopened.
The dashboard reads every project's spend, which needs an Admin token, and this device's token is read-only. Create an Admin token on the web dashboard
under Settings → Devices and clients and connect with it.
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.
Opened from 📊 in the sidebar strip, which is shown active. It reads GET /usage/all (Admin), polls every 60 s, and ⟳ / F5 reads it again.
The header picker (calendar glyph) offers This month, Last month, All time, Today, Last 7 days and Last 30 days. The day/month unit switches the charts to 'Tokens per month' / 'Cost per month'.
Pickers read 'All X ▾'. Project and model pick several ('2 projects ▾'); the others pick one. Clicking a breakdown row toggles it as the filter, and a pick adds ' · only <name>' to the subtitle.
Rings appear only with 3 or more slices: four colours plus a grey 'Other'. The project table shows a bar in its slice colour. A project with no turns, or one removed, is greyed out.
Hovering a bar shows 'Oct 3: 4.1M tok · 62 turns · $21.40' at the right of the chart title. An empty window shows 'No usage recorded in October 2026.' above the insights and the project table.
Provider quotas are not on this screen; they are on each provider's Settings → Status tab.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
